answer: A workable design: lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. Link analysis on reused seeds marks the whole set. Because it works by making the twenty-first clone cost more than the first twenty combined, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The network ties the meadow to sunk effort, uses the quill as an corroborating signal, then requires a haven before any payout.
